title: test/e2e: remove line matching helpers
body:
picking up one of the open points from #18540, the line matching helpers that only return a bool. when one of these fails all you get is "Expected false to be true", the output that did not match is nowhere in the report.

one commit per helper, same as the earlier LineInOutputStartsWith and ErrorGrepString removals:

GrepString - the callers matched a bool and then indexed into the returned lines. now a single matcher on the output array, so a failure prints every line and the pattern:

```
Expect(run.OutputToStringArray()).To(ContainElement(MatchRegexp(`shm on /dev/shm type tmpfs.*size=10240k`)))
```

LineInOutputContains - both users are plain if conditions, strings.Contains does the same without a helper.

LineInOutputContainsTag - repo/tag lookup in a parsed map, replaced with a line regex. dynamic names go through regexp.QuoteMeta. tagOutputToMap had no other user so it goes too.

I left IsJSONOutputValid alone on purpose, the two users are table tests with an expected bool and BeValidJSON() returns an error instead of a mismatch for invalid json, so ToNot() would blow up on the negative rows.

ran the test/utils suite with goecho built, ok in 4.7s, and golangci-lint with the ci tags is clean.
